summary: A tenant advocate asks {board} to look beyond permanent residents' payments when evaluating a building's income.
realLife: Testimony in the 2025 hotel proceeding argued that some SRO buildings received significant income from government contracts or other uses and urged the board to examine those receipts.
gates: The case record identifies the testimony, property uses and any supporting income records.
inGame: needs: testimony, property uses and any supporting income records.

turns.what: They can be considered separately from residential rents.
The minutes preserve the argument as testimony.
